chat.author: Stephen Farrell
chat.text: we have a deltachat group?

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: there are several different deltachat groups related to OpenPGP -- nothing that's IETF formal

chat.author: Stephen Farrell
chat.text: mebbe no harm to send a pointer to the list if considered useful

chat.author: Heiko Schaefer
chat.text: data signing and encryption are currently also implicitly key-flagged as "true"

chat.author: Stephen Farrell
chat.text: please join the queue if you have comments/questions you want to voice...

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: i was trying to avoid the extensibility

chat.author: Aron Wussler
chat.text: I would avoid adding new fields, keep the structure as is

chat.author: Stephen Farrell
chat.text: if otherwise ready, we could "punt" to WGLC?

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: i just proposed --confirm-key-password to sop extract-cert to try to address KOpenPGP: https://gitlab.com/dkg/openpgp-stateless-cli/-/merge_requests/64

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: time-check: we've got more presentations to get to

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: i've locked the queue so we can complete this and then move on

chat.author: Stephen Farrell
chat.text: I guess we have a meta-issue as to how SOP fits with the WG, dunno if people wanna try address that explicitly (on the list)  aroiund about now?

chat.author: Stephen Farrell
chat.text: apologies agaain folks, I have to drop to go do a class, I'll keep a slight eye to zulip but will catch-up via the recording.

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: we could just say that given an equivalence class, if the preferred key has issued a key revocation signature over the fallback key, it effectively works.  This is like a "designated revoker"

chat.author: Daniel Huigens
chat.text: @dkg Yeah I think that's reasonable

chat.author: Aron Wussler
chat.text: I like this idea

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: maybe someone could write guidance like that and offer it as an MR to the replacementkey draft

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: someone™

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: we are at time, and i don't want to keep people over too long.  we'll finish this conversation and then take it to the lsit.

chat.author: Daniel Gillmor
chat.text: list*

chat.author: Aron Wussler
chat.text: Bye
